name: San Bernardino City Unified School District
searchAliases: San Bernardino City Unified School District
districtFact: SBCUSD serves about 47,000 TK-12 students in San Bernardino and publishes a traditional school-year calendar plus separate calendars for Middle College High School and the Inland Career Education Center.

about.title: Which SBCUSD Calendar This Page Covers
about.content: This page covers SBCUSD's traditional school-year calendar. Middle College High School and the Inland Career Education Center publish separate calendars, and individual schools may add campus events.

planningTips.title: SBCUSD Planning Notes
content: Use the minimum-day schedule whenever the traditional calendar marks a minimum day, including the first day of school.
Elementary parent-teacher conference dates may change dismissal times even when other grade levels keep a regular day.
Middle College High School and the Inland Career Education Center follow separate calendars.
Check the official school-year calendar page and campus notices before making plans around a revised date.

compareIntro: This table compares SBCUSD with selected Southern California districts using each district's published 2026-27 calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Does every SBCUSD school follow the traditional calendar?
districtFaqs.a: No. This page covers SBCUSD's traditional calendar. Middle College High School and the Inland Career Education Center publish separate calendars, linked below.

districtFaqs.q: Where can I check for SBCUSD calendar changes?
districtFaqs.a: Check SBCUSD's official School Year Calendars page and your school's campus notices. MySchoolDates records the date of its latest source review, but district and school announcements are the final authority.

relatedDistricts.name: Riverside Unified School District
relatedDistricts.comparisonNote: Starts August 10 and ends May 27, giving Riverside a later start and earlier finish than SBCUSD.

relatedDistricts.name: Los Angeles Unified School District
relatedDistricts.comparisonNote: Starts August 12, nine days after SBCUSD; both districts use the same Winter Recess dates.

relatedDistricts.name: Santa Ana Unified School District
relatedDistricts.comparisonNote: Starts August 10. Its Spring Break begins April 5, two weeks after SBCUSD's begins March 22.
